name: zero-server-node-workspace
description: The Node binding workspace: the napi-rs crate at this directory, @zero-server/native with the compiled core under packages/native, @zero-server/core over it, and the @zero-server/sdk facade.

scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:facade
scripts.build:debug: napi build --platform --package-json-path packages/native/package.json --output-dir packages/native && npm run build:facade
